info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Willow Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Willow Produce Detail Management API allows users to efficiently submit and manage detailed information about willow produce catalogs. This endpoint facilitates the addition of new items to the catalog, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records. Common consumers include agriculture businesses, supply chain managers, and inventory systems that require precise produce data. This API enhances the visibility and organization of produce details for better decision-making.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create new details for Willow Produce. It accepts a payload with the necessary data to define these details. Utilize this API to effectively manage and update information related to your Willow Produce offerings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to willow produce operations. Ensure that all required fields are included in the JSON payload.

200.description: Successfully processed the request and returned the requested details.

CreateCatalogWillowProduceDetailRequest.title: Willow Produce Post Request Body

willow_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the willow produce.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of willow produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the willow produce.

CreateCatalogWillowProduceDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for posting details about willow produce operations.

CreateCatalogWillowProduceDetailResponse.title: Response for Willow Produces Details Operations

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogWillowProduceDetailResponse.description: This schema represents the response format for the operations performed on the details of the willow produce.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource that has been returned. This header informs the client about the content format of the response payload.

x-processing-time.description: Specifies the time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. This information is useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
